payload.title: Bilevel Optimization of Agent Skills via Monte Carlo Tree Search
payload.abstract_truncated:
arXiv:2604.15709v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Agent \texttt{skills} are structured collections of instructions, tools, and supporting resources that help large language model (LLM) agents perform particular classes of tasks. Empirical evidence shows that the design of \texttt{skills} can materially affect agent task performance, yet systematically optimizing \texttt{skills} remains challenging.
